family_summaries.talin: Nine talin-screened candidates comprise five architecture-retaining talin proteins, one partial-architecture talin-like protein and three HIP1R-like proteins. Two conserved talin clades are separated from OG0001835 HIP1R relatives.
family_summaries.kindlin: Six kindlin-related proteins form a broadly conserved shorter OG0001282 lineage and a longer Schistosoma-restricted OG0013508 lineage.
family_summaries.vinculin: Six vinculin-family proteins form canonical-vinculin and catenin-related clades. Their extended vinculin-family architecture is retained in both.
family_summaries.alpha_actinin: Fifteen actin-linking candidates include compact canonical alpha-actinin, extended spectrin-related and parasite-divergent spectrin lineages.
family_summaries.cofilin: Fifteen ADF-family candidates resolve into cofilin/ADF, twinfilin, drebrin and GMF-like lineages.
family_summaries.filamin: Six canonical-architecture filamin candidates form two conserved paralogous clades within OG0000767.
family_summaries.paxillin_like: Fifteen broadly LIM-scaffold candidates include two-LIM, four-LIM without a paxillin domain, PDZ-LIM, PET-LIM/LIMPETin and PET-lacking five-LIM lineages. Repeated LIM domains alone do not make all candidates canonical paxillin.
family_summaries.PINCH_like: Two five-LIM, PINCH-signature lineages distinguish broadly conserved and Schistosoma-restricted PINCH proteins.
family_summaries.zyxin_like: The three OG0002012 scaffold candidates have Ajuba-related LIM2 signatures.
family_summaries.FAK: Three FAK-clade candidates share OG0002086. MS3_00002824 has complete architecture; EWB00_007322 lacks Focal-AT and Smp_137610 lacks FERM.
family_summaries.ILK: The canonical ILK-like triplet is OG0003976. The broader ILK screen also contains GS-domain membrane kinases, MK2-like, OSR1-like and other partial-configuration kinase lineages.
family_summaries.Src: Twenty-two architecture-configured Src-screened proteins span Src-like, PH/BTK-containing, ABL2-related and two additional SH3-SH2-kinase lineages; these subfamilies remain explicit.
family_summaries.Nck: Three Nck-like adaptors retain three SH3 domains plus SH2 and conserved metazoan orthology.
family_summaries.Shc: Three Shc-like adaptors retain PTB-SH2 architecture and conserved metazoan orthology.
family_summaries.Grb2: Five SH3-SH2-SH3 adaptors distinguish a conserved Grb2 triplet from a two-species Schistosoma-restricted lineage.
family_summaries.PTP_PEST: Ten broadly PTP-PEST-related candidates distinguish PTPN1-related, receptor-PTP-related, Xenopus-linked and singleton phosphatase lineages.
family_summaries.collagen_like: The broad collagen repertoire contains six orthogroups; the narrative individually describes collagen IV-like, V-like, I-like, Schistosoma-restricted fibrillar and short-fragment groups. Candidate ligand identity remains separate from receptor binding.
family_summaries.laminin_like: Fifteen laminin-domain proteins distinguish laminin beta-, gamma- and alpha-like scaffolds from a six-protein netrin-like lineage.
family_summaries.fibronectin_like: FN3-containing proteins include ROBO-like, UNC-89/obscurin/SPEG-like, Eph-like, DCC/neogenin-like and type IIa RPTP-like architectures; FN3 presence alone does not assign a ligand role.

normalizations: OG000229 in the final cofilin sentence is normalized to OG0002291, as explicitly named earlier in the same paragraph.
Vinculin clade orthogroup IDs are taken from the catalogue; the narrative does not assign the two listed IDs to individual clades.
Unenumerated collagen and kinase lineages retain their catalogue annotations.
